svg.aria-label: Alizarin + metal ion (mordant) → insoluble coloured chelate (lake)
svg.title: Alizarin + metal ion (mordant) → insoluble coloured chelate (lake)
svg.desc: Alizarin forms a six-membered chelate ring with aluminium ion giving the red lake
svg.text: Alizarin + metal ion (mordant) → insoluble coloured chelate (lake)
Chelation uses the 1-OH (peri to C=O at C-9): the metal binds the phenoxide O and the carbonyl O.
Real lakes are Al/Ca complexes of several alizarin molecules (Turkey red); colour depends on the metal.
